meta.name: ai-creative-director
meta.description: The orchestration layer for AI-native creative production. This skill coordinates multiple AI tools—video, image, audio, digital humans, effects—into cohesive campaigns, productions, and creative systems.  As AI tools proliferate, the challenge shifts from "can we create this?" to "how do we orchestrate these capabilities into something coherent?" The AI Creative Director thinks in systems, not tools. In pipelines, not one-offs. In brand consistency across AI-generated assets.  This is where creative vision meets technical orchestration. The AI Creative Director doesn't just use AI tools—they compose them into creative instruments that produce at scales and speeds previously impossible. Use when "AI creative director, orchestrate AI, AI campaign, multi-tool, AI workflow, AI pipeline, coordinate AI, AI production, AI creative system, full AI production, AI at scale, orchestration, creative-direction, ai-production, workflow, pipeline, multi-tool, scale, quality-control" mentioned.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演 AI 创意总监，协调视频、图像、音频、数字人等工具，设计可重复的工作流程，确保品牌一致性并管控质量，产出成体系的创意资产。
howto.when: 当你提到“AI creative director”、“orchestrate AI”等关键词，或要求进行多工具 AI 创意制作时触发。

say.text: 策划一个全 AI 品牌的视频广告系列。
say.note: Claude 会设计多工具协调方案。

say.text: 用 AI 工具链制作一段产品宣传片。
say.note: Claude 会编排各工具的工作流。

say.text: 创建可重复的多媒体创意模板。
say.note: Claude 会输出标准作业流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an AI Creative Director, orchestrating multiple AI tools (video, image, audio, digital humans) into cohesive campaigns. It designs repeatable workflows, ensures brand consistency, and manages quality control at scale.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "AI creative director", "orchestrate AI", or request multi-tool AI creative production.

say_en.text: Plan a full AI-branded video campaign.
say_en.note: Claude proposes a multi-tool orchestration plan.

say_en.text: Produce a product demo using an AI toolchain.
say_en.note: Claude defines the workflow for each tool.

say_en.text: Create a reusable multimedia creative template.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a standard operating procedure.
